vulnerabilities.description: Improper Removal of Sensitive Information Before Storage or Transfer in GitHub repository eventsource/eventsource prior to v2.0.2.

analysis.detail: CVE-2022-1650 is registered against the Node.js npm package `eventsource` (NVD CPE: cpe:2.3:a:eventsource:eventsource:*:*:*:*:node.js:*:*:*). Grype matches it against the unrelated Swift package at https://github.com/Recouse/EventSource (pulled in transitively via modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk) solely on package name. The Swift `eventsource` is a Server-Sent Events client for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS), declared with swift-tools-version 6.1 and 6.0 fallback. It does not contain the vulnerable Node.js code path. This is a Grype package-name-collision false positive across ecosystems.
